primitives.verbatim_quote: # Workflow Generation Workflows are higher-level generation flows exposed separately from the model catalog.
primitives.assumptions: All workflows delegate to underlying generation job infrastructure.

primitives.name: Workflow Credit Cost Estimation
primitives.verbatim_quote: ```bash higgsfield generate cost workflow draw_to_video --duration 8.2 --resolution 720p higgsfield generate cost workflow reframe --duration 7.1 --resolution 1080p ``` If the user asks "how much will this workflow cost?", run cost first and report credits before creating.
primitives.assumptions: Costs scale linearly with duration and resolution parameters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure mode occurs when unsupported resolution or duration values are provided.

layer2.mapping: GSI's cost prediction engine maps workflow metadata to credit consumption models consistent with GSE's computational resource tracking.
layer2.telemetry: Estimated vs actual credit usage variance per workflow type.
